insight: Founded in 2019; raised a $52M a16z-led Series B with data-warehouse Snowflake joining as a strategic investor.
name: Hex
tagline: Agentic analytics notebook for SQL, Python, and R data teams.
description: A collaborative data workspace combining SQL, Python, and R notebooks with shareable data apps. Its Notebook Agent and Magic AI generate queries, debug code, run exploratory analysis, and build visualizations as editable notebook cells. Built for data teams that need reproducible, governed analysis rather than one-off chat answers.

modelSupport.notes: AI agent generates SQL/Python/R; runs across leading LLMs behind the product.

edge: AI analysis lands as editable, reproducible notebook cells, then ships as governed data apps — not throwaway chat answers.
pros: SQL, Python, and R in one workspace
cons: Basic code completion vs some rivals
Notebook model has a learning curve
